about_the_game:
This is a collection of background illustrations perfect for visual novels, simulation games, and other story-driven titles set in modern-day Japan.

Each scene includes multiple time-of-day variations: Day, Evening, Night - Lights On, and Night - Lights Off (some are Rainy version)

A great addition for anyone creating everyday slice-of-life scenes!

*******************************************

pictures: 39 backgrounds (each in 816×624 and 1280×720)

*******************************************

・This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.

・OK to be used in Commercial projects made in RPG Maker

・You may modify some of the assets (but not redistribute them) for your own game use only.

short_description: This is a single image of a modern Japanese city, suitable for novel games and simulation games. Time differences are included for day, evening, lights on at night, and lights off at night (with some rain). Please make use of them in your game productions that deal with everyday scenes.
